summary: Behaviour change: after a pick in the built-in full-screen chat list, a shell without an editor or textarea outside the column now focuses a data-glirastes-composer element or the chats toggle instead of the list's "New chat" button.
howTo: Nothing to do for a textarea or editor composer (focus unchanged). An <input> or own composer gets focus after a pick when it (or a wrapper around its input) carries data-glirastes-composer; without the mark focus goes to the chats toggle. A disabled RichMentionInput (contenteditable="false") and a contenteditable="plaintext-only" editor also lead to the chats toggle. Tests that expected focus on "New chat" after a pick expect the composer or the toggle (button[data-action="history"]). Opening the assistant and alt+shift+I are unchanged. See placing-the-assistant.md, Replacing shell parts.
